author: Nintendo of America
description:
Experience a variety of STAR WARS games only in Fortnite on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fortnite-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1064-01&utm_id=P1064-01 

Everything from single-player role-playing games to shooters and tycoons await! Choose from Galactic Siege, Escape Vader, Droid Tycoon, and more STAR WARS games made by independent Fortnite developers. And on May 19, Fortnite will also be the only way you can join up with friends and catch the first 10 minute of Jon Favreau's Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu film!
